Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class DealRules

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.DealRules
public class DealRules extends Object
The deal lifecycle that all three portals share: what happens to a listing, its other offers and the people involved when a deal is accepted, completed or returned, or when a listing's open offers must be declined. See docs/state-machines.md.

Who calls what:

  • accept(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Offer) — the seller's Manage Offers & Requests (step 3.3).
  • declineOpenOffers(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Listing, com.hkust.marketplace.models.NotificationCategory, java.lang.String) — the seller's Manage Listings (A3), the admin's listing removal (5.5.4) and account deactivation or deletion (6.2.4, 6.4.4).
  • complete(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Offer) — the buyer's Manage My Deals (UC7 steps 6-8).
  • returnItem(com.hkust.marketplace.models.BorrowRequest, boolean) — the buyer's self-return (UC7 A2) and the borrowing-deadline timer (UC12 step 3).

This is a control class for business logic, not tied to one actor. It does not check the logged-in user: the calling service checks the role first (AccessControl), then calls these methods. Each method is one atomic step, and it can also run inside the caller's transaction.

  • Method Details

    • accept

      public void accept(Offer offer)
      The seller accepts a pending offer, borrow request or claim (Manage Offers & Requests 3.3.3-3.3.6; UC7 Special Requirement 5): the offer is Accepted, the listing becomes Reserved (sale, giveaway) or Lent (lend), every other open offer on the listing is declined, and each affected buyer is notified.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the offer is not pending, the listing is no longer Live (A2), or it is a borrow request whose period has already ended

    • declineOpenOffers

      public List<Offer> declineOpenOffers(Listing listing, NotificationCategory category, String because)
      Declines every pending or countered offer on the listing and notifies each buyer: "Your claim for 'Desk Lamp' was declined because {because}."
      Parameters:
      category - OFFER_UPDATE normally, or LISTING_REMOVED when the admin removed the listing (Task 1.8)
      because - why, completing the sentence, such as "the admin removed the listing"
      Returns:
      the offers that were declined

    • complete

      public void complete(Offer deal)
      The buyer marks an accepted price offer or claim complete (UC7 steps 6-8): the deal gets today's completion date, the listing becomes Sold or Given (or stays Removed), and the seller is notified.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for a borrow request, which is completed by returning the item
      ServiceException - if the deal is not accepted or is already completed

    • returnItem

      public void returnItem(BorrowRequest request, boolean automatic)
      Returns a borrowed item, either by the buyer (UC7 A2) or automatically when the borrowing period ends (UC12 step 3). The listing becomes Live again unless the admin removed it, and the seller is notified; for an automatic return the buyer is notified too. Only the first return counts (UC12 Special Requirement 5).

      Checking that a self-return happens before the due date (UC7 Special Requirement 3) is the caller's job, because only Manage My Deals has that rule.

      Parameters:
      automatic - true for UC12: the completion date is the due date and the deal is marked auto-returned
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the request is not accepted or the item was already returned
